changelog: Initial release: add language translations to customer service templates, sync to Feishu Wiki, create GitHub issues
summary: Add new language translations to customer service response templates and sync them across Feishu Wiki, GitHub, and local files. Use when: (1) adding new languages to KB templates, (2) updating multilingual customer service responses, (3) syncing template changes to Feishu Wiki knowledge base, (4) creating GitHub issues to document template updates, (5) running the full multilingual template update pipeline. Triggers on phrases like "add language", "translate template", "sync to wiki", "update customer service templates", "多语言模板", "新增语种", "同步知识库".
